spec_family.name: New Construction Wood Wall Stain/Clear Coat
spec_family.description: Covers stain application, sanding sealer, and clear topcoat for wood wall panel/board surfaces in new construction. Combined spec with coating_type dimension (stain_clear, stain_only, clear_only). Stain phase includes wipe step for all methods. Sealer and clear phases use independent application method selection. Uses SF as primary UOM. Wall_style (shiplap, tongue_groove, panel) drives production rate modifier. Spray is common production method for large field surfaces. Material systems are product-role-based recommendations — contractor retains discretion. Context prefix WWST avoids collision with paint counterpart SF_WOOD_WALL_NC (prefix WDWL).

includes: Stain application on bare wood wall panels/boards (brush+wipe, roll+wipe, spray+wipe)
Sanding sealer application (0-2 coats, QT-driven defaults)
Clear topcoat application (1-3 coats, QT-driven defaults)
Bare wood preparation (inspect, sand 120-150 grit, fill defects with wood filler, grain raise for waterborne, tack clean)
Wood conditioner application (softwood + stain, unless gel stain)
Interstage sanding between sealer coats (220-320 grit)
Interstage sanding between clear coats (320-400 grit)
Stain dry verification before sealer/clear application
Floor protection (full for spray, perimeter for brush)
Ceiling edge masking (spray or when ceiling is SS_PAINTED_*)
Adjacent trim masking (when spraying near finished trim)
Tongue and groove wood wall stain/clear coat
Flat/raised panel wood wall stain/clear coat

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary configuration dimension — drives layer stack, material systems, and module activation.
configuration_dimensions.notes: stain_clear is the professional standard. stain_only is rare (unprotected). clear_only for natural wood or pre-stained.

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection scrutiny, sanding discipline, and coat count defaults.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=budget (1 stain + 0 sealer + 1 clear = 2 coats). QT4=standard (1 stain + 1 sealer + 2 clear = 4 coats). QT5 not applicable — wood walls are field surfaces, not focal-point millwork.

configuration_dimensions.description: Stain application technique. All stain methods include a wipe step.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray is default for large field surfaces — most efficient. Roll is fast for flat areas. Brush for detail. All methods include wipe-back step.

configuration_dimensions.description: Clear coat application technique. No roll option — causes air bubbles in clear coat.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray is default for large wall surfaces. Brush for occupied/small areas. Roll PROHIBITED for clear coat.

configuration_dimensions.description: Clear coat sheen. Drives product selection.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Satin is most popular for residential wood walls. No sheen/QT gate.
1 coat is standard. 2 coats for deeper color.
QT3 skips sealer (budget). QT4 uses 1 coat.
QT3 uses 1 coat. QT4 uses 2 coats.

configuration_dimensions.description: Wood wall construction type. Drives production rate modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: shiplap=1.15x (V-groove detail at each joint, stain pools in grooves). tongue_groove=1.10x (tight joints, less groove detail). panel=1.00x baseline (flat panel surfaces). Wood wall staining typically more complex than painting due to grain attention.

configuration_dimensions.description: Wood species grouping. Drives wood conditioner activation for softwood.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Softwood requires pre-stain wood conditioner unless gel stain.

paintable_items.name: Wood wall panel/board surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total SF of wood wall surface from floor to ceiling. Includes board faces and joint detail (shiplap, T&G) or panel faces. Sourced from PaintScope input PS_SURFACE_SF.WOOD_WALL.
paintable_items.notes: Single SF item. Height varies per room — estimation engine applies height modifier via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND. Wall_style modifier captures groove/joint complexity.

variants.notes: Budget spray — most common NC production scenario for wood walls. 2 total coats.
Standard spray. 4 total coats. Professional residential standard.
Production variant. Roll stain (speed on large field) + spray clear (finish quality).
Clear-only spray on natural or pre-stained wood. 3 coats.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Total SF of wood wall surface
Full floor protection area for spray method
Perimeter floor protection for brush method

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: spray method or ceiling is SS_PAINTED_*
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Ceiling edge masking LF at wall-ceiling junction

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: spray method and trim is finished
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Trim masking LF near spray zone

protection_zones_required.notes: Full floor coverage for spray. Stain drips and overspray from large wall surfaces.
Perimeter drop cloths for brush/roll method.
Tape + paper at ceiling-wall junction for spray. Also required when ceiling is SS_PAINTED_*.
Mask adjacent finished trim during spray. Stain penetrates and cannot be wiped off finished trim.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Wood wall meets ceiling directly. Different finish — stained wall vs painted ceiling.
Baseboard often stained with same stain/clear. Handled by SF_TRIM_NC_STAIN.
Adjacent drywall at inside corner transitions.

valid_input_states.notes: Bare wood is primary input. clear_only also accepts SS_STAINED.

site_condition_rules.effect: Floor protection excluded when floor is subfloor.
Height modifier: H2=1.30 for 9-12ft, H3=1.50 for 13ft+.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Wood wall staining typically occurs BEFORE wall finishing in NC. Staining requires bare wood.
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Setup > Prep (sand, fill, grain raise, condition) > Stain coat 1 (+wipe) > [Stain coat 2] > Stain dry > Sealer > Sealer sand > Clear coat 1 > [Clear interstage > Clear coat 2] > Final inspect > Cleanup

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft. Wood wall stain/clear coat with coating_type dimension, wall_style modifier (shiplap/tongue_groove/panel), QT3-QT4, spray-default for large field surfaces, 14-module SOP architecture inherited from trim stain canonical. Context prefix WWST.
